text:
ashley: hitting an escalation from a customer — python streaming generator stops yielding after a partial token when we rotate creds.

ashley: repro steps attached, seems to happen under retry+auth-refresh, probably SDK retry timing + SSE parse boundary. :frown:

mike: can you paste the minimal repro and logs?

sarah: saw something similar last month but that was utf8 split, this looks different (auth or retry interleaving).

ashley: minimal gist:
```py
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
for chunk in cli.stream_generate(model='llama-3-mini'):
    print(chunk)
```

ashley: logs:
```
INFO 2134567891 >> open stream, id=abc123
INFO 2134567892 >> data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel"}}]}
INFO 2134567893 >> data: {"event":"keepalive"}
INFO 2134567894 >> auth refresh start
INFO 2134567895 >> retry/refresh completed, new token applied
INFO 2134567896 >> data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"lo wor"}}]}
INFO 2134567897 >> data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"ld"}}]}
INFO 2134567898 >> stream generator hung, no more yields
```

mike: interesting — the server kept sending data but generator stopped? any exceptions in the client?

ashley: no exception, generator just never resumes. can reproduce locally with intermittent token rotate (force expiry).

raj: which SDK version? we had a fix for mid-event auth in 0.8.3 that touches SSE parsing boundaries.

ashley: customer is on 0.8.1. i repro with 0.8.1 but 0.8.3 seems to mitigate (still testing).

sarah: 0.8.3 changed the chunk buffer flush timing; there was also a retry backoff change that could lead to swallowed keepalives.

mike: can you try 0.8.3 and enable debug SSE logs (RW_SDK_DEBUG=1) and paste the raw bytes?

ashley: did that — raw shows a keepalive newline split across the token swap boundary: "\n\n\ndata: {\"choices\":...}\n\n" and then auth handshake logs interleaved. looks like parser state machine loses the partial event.

raj: this matches a bug where _parse_event only processes whole lines and ignores a trailing partial line if an auth hook preempts the read loop. PR #512 fixes by preserving partial suffix when rotating tokens.

ashley: customer is on a monthly job, blocked. what's the recommended immediate mitigation?

mike: short term: pin to 0.8.3 if possible (we think it unblocks). alternatively, disable automatic auth refresh by setting client.auth_refresh=False and rotate externally, but that's heavier.

ashley: will try pin+verify, sharing repro steps with customer. also raising a support case to escalate to eng if they can't upgrade.

raj: i'll cut a hotfix branch to backport the partial-suffix-preserve behavior to 0.8.2 patch if needed.

support-bot: created ticket RW-3219 and assigned to eng-oncall. ETA: triage in 2h. :white_check_mark:

ashley: thanks — i'll post results from customer tests. :thumbsup:
